The *New Mokama Ganga Railway Bridge* project is one of the most important rail infrastructure developments in Bihar. Built parallel to the old Rajendra Setu, this *1.9 km dual-track railway bridge* will significantly improve train connectivity between *Patna, Barauni, Howrah, & North Bihar.*
• What’s Covered in this Video:*
• Location & route overview (Mokama, Hathidah, Barauni)
• Difference between old Rajendra Setu & new railway bridge
• Project cost, length & key features
• 9 small bridges, 2 road overbridges & 3 rail overbridges
• New Hathidah Upper Railway Station construction update
